scope.observation_unit: one P9016 cell; 20 linked chromosome measurements; not biological replicates
scope.cpu_anchor_policy: 020 and 033 CPU outputs are historical anchors/diagnostics only; neither is a GPU endpoint or biological replicate
scope.cpu_034_role: stopped_or_terminating_legacy_attempt; never a release input for the unified GPU run
scope.gpu_training_plan: all 5 variants x 2 sources x 3 layers = 30 stages, each restarted from the original 014 source

training_definition.gpu_training_plan: all 5 variants x 2 sources x 3 layers = 30 stages, each restarted from the original 014 source
training_definition.source_origin: original 014 consensus_joint(base1103)/random_joint(base2207) raw blind source; both are two-copy initialization sources for 40-track endpoints
training_definition.variant_policy: each variant runs both original blind sources through all three layers
training_definition.c0_gate_policy: GPU C0 two-track numeric no-reference gate before the remaining 24 GPU stage attempts; CPU 033/020 gates remain independent historical anchors and are not the GPU C0 group

backend_policy.decision_reason: 028 historical scoped benchmark was approximately 3504 s on CPU versus 58.9 s on GPU; the main 30-stage experiment therefore uses one GPU backend, while CPU/GPU endpoint differences are diagnosed rather than used as a rejection threshold

endpoint_selection.tie_action: choose the first source in the pre-registered order among values within 1e-9 of the minimum

evaluation_definition.metric_name: Spearman-derived R2 geometry readout; not statistical R-squared
evaluation_definition.genomic_join: numeric chromosome plus integer base-pair coordinate

common_mask.policy: reuse the published 029 21-condition common mask exactly
common_mask.mask_reconstruction: reconstruct pair indices from the locked 21 historical inputs after release hash checks; compare all 20 expected pair counts

orientation.selection: one whole-chromosome candidate best-swap by larger matched geometry
orientation.tie_result: unresolved; contrast=0; named margins n/a; no both-positive credit

na_rules.missing_one_copy: all four-rho two-copy metrics n/a; never average one valid copy
na_rules.unresolved_tie: named margins n/a and no both-positive credit

evaluation_definition.selection_policy: R2 reads the locked training count selection; it never recomputes or changes representative selection
evaluation_definition.uncertainty_policy: no p-values, confidence intervals, or new hypothesis tests in this boxplot deliverable

plot_definition.main: five GPU count-selected representatives plus one gray historical CPU anchor labeled 020 / C0 CPU; the anchor is not a GPU endpoint
plot_definition.supplement: consensus_joint_base1103 and random_joint_base2207 strata for the five GPU conditions only

historical_cpu_anchor.label: 020 / C0 CPU
historical_cpu_anchor.role: historical same-mask diagnostic anchor, not a biological replicate and not a GPU selection input
historical_cpu_anchor.source: published 020 v1_original_random_joint parity plus locked CPU C0 context

plot_definition.paired_delta: within each source and chromosome, variant endpoint minus C0 endpoint for all four metrics
plot_definition.observation_note: 20 points are linked measurements from one cell, not biological replicates

figure.bbox_policy: explicit margins; do not crop text; no overlapping labels
figure.distance_colormap: not applicable; no new distance heatmap

release_gate.reference_read_rule: only after every candidate coordinate, historical mask input, selection, terminal, source, code, and protocol hash is locked
required_proofs: all 10 GPU endpoint paths and SHA256 values or explicit terminal failure records
source identifiers and source input/snapshot hashes for both blind sources
complete terminal evidence for all 10 GPU training endpoints
train-only count_nll_per_record (reported as final count_nll_normalized) selection proof for all five GPU variants
GPU C0 two-track numeric no-reference gate PASS

prepare_mode_opens: preparation config/protocol/release template and published mask metadata only

post_release_acceptance.purpose: prove the new GPU implementation preserved the same 029 common mask and historical 020 random R2 readout; compare GPU C0 to CPU history only as a non-blocking diagnostic

mask_comparison.comparison: exact array equality per chromosome, not pair-count equality

post_release_acceptance.c0_rule: compare the locked GPU C0 representative to the historical CPU 020 random readout only as a CPU-GPU diagnostic; a numeric difference is non-blocking and must never reject GPU training or GPU label-free selection

gpu_cpu_diagnostic.comparison: GPU C0 selected representative versus historical CPU 020 / C0 anchor under the same frozen mask
